data.narrative:
Amber Bio is a seed-stage biotech company founded by Basem Al-Shayeb and Jacob Borrajo that has raised $26M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a universe of 3 public comparables in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Stage-progression methodology is the applicable triangulation approach here. Using total capital raised ($26M) as a proxy for seed-stage valuation and applying a typical 2.5x multiplier for progression to the next financing stage yields an implied valuation of $65M. Peer-median analysis could not be applied due to insufficient narrow comparables within the seed stage or adjacent tranches that would satisfy statistical rigor (minimum 3 datapoints). Public-comp anchoring via the sector P/S median of 9.2x is inapplicable absent disclosed revenue figures, which private companies rarely make public.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $55M (low) to $75M (high), with $65M as the median point. This narrow range reflects reliance on a single applicable method, which is a material constraint. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue data to cross-validate against public biotech multiples and limited disclosure from similarly-staged private peers. Additional visibility into Amber Bio's clinical progress, IP position, and capital efficiency would strengthen conviction in this range.
